description: This file defines a REST controller for managing insurance policy products within a Java Spring Boot application. It includes endpoints for creating policies, updating premiums, listing all policies, and filtering by type. The class interacts with a service layer and uses annotations for request mapping, security, and documentation.

classes.name: PolicyController
classes.description: REST controller providing endpoints for policy management, including creation, updating premiums, listing, and filtering policies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new policy product, restricted to ADMIN role. Accepts a CreatePolicyRequest object and returns the created Policy.

methods.name: updatePremium
methods.description: Updates the base premium of a specified policy by policy ID; restricted to ADMIN role.

methods.name: listAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all policies, accessible to any authenticated user.

methods.name: byType
methods.description: Fetches policies filtered by a specified PolicyType.
